messages:
noah_cs: Heads-up: HarvestAI renewal in 12 days. They logged onboarding latency spikes and asked about credits. Need an evidence package (uptime, route p95/p99, incident timeline), a recommended credit number, and a customer-friendly note. I can own the send.

sam_eng: I'll grab route-level percentiles and raw traces from Console. Which percentile do we prioritize for their interactive flows?

noah_cs: p95 for chat.interactive (customer mentioned p95 regressions), p99 for batch ingest.

vivian_se: I'll assemble the onboarding checklist and highlight the KV cache migration step that overlapped with the spike window. Also note the model-pin rollback we executed.

marcus_am: Contract terms: >0.75% credit requires legal review. Keep recommendation under that if possible.

gloria_sre: Infra note: autoscaler experienced a 90s cold-start on 2026-02-07 after a deploy, which matched one of the client-reported incidents. We applied warm-pool + pre-warm policy afterwards. I'll paste incident fragment.

ops-bot: SLO snapshot created: https://console.redwood.ai/slo/harvestai/snapshot/2026-03-02T09:15Z

sam_eng: Quick query I used:
```
-- per-route p95/p99 and uptime over 90d
SELECT route,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95_ms,
  percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p99_ms,
  100*sum(case when success then 1 else 0 end)/count(*) AS uptime_pct
FROM telemetry.requests
WHERE customer_id='harvestai' AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY route;
```
I'll attach CSV.

sam_eng: Pasted summary: chat.interactive p95=340ms (target 200ms), p99=980ms (target 600ms), uptime=99.76% (target 99.9%). ingest.bulk p95=420ms (target 500ms), p99=1.8s (target 2.5s), uptime=99.995%. The customer-visible regression is clearly chat.interactive.

vivian_se: Noted. Onboarding notes: KV migration started 2026-01-15, completed 2026-01-20; we rolled back model-pin on 2026-01-18 at 04:12Z for stability. Attach exact commits.

marcus_am: Given ~0.14% uptime shortfall on the interactive route and p95 overshoot by 140ms, propose offering a 0.4% invoice credit plus a free 1-hour optimization workshop. Keeps us under legal review threshold and shows proactive support.

billing-bot: Preliminary credit calc: 0.4% of committed monthly spend = $Y (will replace Y with actual invoice line once provided).

gloria_sre: Recommend including the deploy postmortem link and infra remediation (warm pool, adjusted scaler thresholds). Also call out the transient 3m error burst correlated with deploy.

noah_cs: Draft customer note outline: 1) acknowledge and timeline, 2) attach SLO snapshot + per-route table, 3) explain root causes and fixes, 4) offer 0.4% credit + workshop, 5) ask if they want a deep dive. I'll write it once numbers are finalized.

sam_eng: Uploaded CSV: https://console.redwood.ai/exports/harvestai/90d-slo-2026-03.csv and traces bundle: https://console.redwood.ai/traces/harvestai/2026-03-02.tar.gz

vivian_se: Uploaded onboarding checklist with timestamps and rollback commit: https://drive.redwood.ai/harvestai/onboarding-checklist.md

ops-bot: Snapshot archived to /evidence/harvestai/2026-03-02-ops-snapshot.tar.gz

marcus_am: I'll prep the legal-safe credit wording: "We propose a one-time invoice credit equal to 0.4% of the monthly committed spend for the affected month. Acceptance of this credit is without admission of liability and will not alter other contractual terms."

noah_cs: Action items:
- sam_eng: confirm final p95/p99 CSV and highlight the 3 largest error windows (ETA 2h)
- gloria_sre: paste deploy/infra postmortem link + config diffs (ETA EOD)
- vivian_se: final onboarding checklist + mitigations (ETA EOD)
- marcus_am: final credit text + approval path (ETA EOD)
- billing-bot: compute actual dollar value once invoice line provided

sam_eng: Will add the three error window snippets and attach flamegraphs.

vivian_se: Will mark the KV cache migration as "root cause candidate" in the checklist and include the post-rollback verification run results.

noah_cs: I'll assemble the bundle and share draft note for internal review before sending to customer. Please ping if any changes. :thumbsup:

marcus_am: If they accept the workshop instead of credit, we can include a 30-day SLA target commitment with follow-up metrics. Good leverage.

noah_cs: Great point. I'll put both options in the draft: credit + workshop or workshop only with a 30-day follow-up.

billing-bot: Awaiting committed spend line item to calculate final credit dollar amount.

noah_cs: Thanks team — closing thread for now, will re-open if new evidence pops up.
